headline: Executive order sets out how the federal government will run the Midway Islands, a small U.S. territory in the Pacific.
what_it_does: This order deals with who in the federal government is in charge of running the Midway Islands. Only the title was available, so the exact rules and which agency was given control are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order sets out which part of the government handles running the islands.

who_it_affects.group: People living, working, or visiting on Midway
who_it_affects.how: The order may change which federal office oversees rules and services on the islands.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, October 31, 1996 (not confirmed by the source material)
